draft.subject: Getting Ridge Media's first project set up
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

I know you've had a few notes from us already, so I'll keep this short. Nothing has been set up in Wrenfield yet, and I'd rather help than keep nudging.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the fastest way to see whether it fits how Ridge Media works. There's an in-app onboarding flow that walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Nadia
